name: Wide Slits: Closely-Spaced Fringes
description: Set the slit separation to maximum (36 px). According to the double-slit equation d sin(theta) = n lambda, wider separation produces more closely-spaced interference fringes. Count the number of bright bands and compare with narrow separation.

successCriteria.description: Observe many closely-spaced interference fringes at maximum separation
Count the number of bright radial bands visible

hints.message: Wider separation (d) = more fringes = narrower spacing. This is the inverse relationship: fringe spacing proportional to lambda/d.
